kv14.8:2.5: Diṭṭhigatasampayuttā vedanā --pe-- saññā --pe-- cetanā --pe-- cittaṃ akusalan ti?
kv14.8:3.7: Hañci saphalaṃ savipākaṃ, no vata re vattabbe
kv14.8:4.3: Nanu micchādiṭṭhiparamāni vajjāni vuttāni Bhagavatā ti?
kv14.8:4.5: Hañci micchādiṭṭhiparamāni vajjāni vuttāni Bhagavatā, no vata re vattabbe
kv14.8:5.4: "Micchādiṭṭhi kho Vaccha akusalā, sammādiṭṭhi kusalā ti."
kv14.8:6.4: "Micchādiṭṭhissa kho ahaṃ Puṇṇa dvinnaṃ gatīnaṃ aññataraṃ gatiṃ vadāmi,
kv14.8:7.5: "Sassato loko ti kho Vaccha abyākataṃ etaṃ,
kv14.8:7.6: asassato loko ti kho Vaccha abyākataṃ etaṃ,
kv14.8:7.7: antavā loko ti kho Vaccha abyākataṃ etaṃ,
kv14.8:7.9: taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīran ti kho Vaccha --pe--
kv14.8:7.10: aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīran ti kho Vaccha --pe--
kv14.8:7.11: hoti Tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā ti kho Vaccha --pe--
kv14.8:7.12: na hoti Tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā ti kho Vaccha --pe--
kv14.8:7.13: hoti ca na ca hoti Tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā ti kho Vaccha --pe--
kv14.8:7.14: n' eva hoti na na hoti Tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā ti kho Vaccha abyākataṃ etan ti."
kv14.8:8.4: "Micchādiṭṭhikassa Bhikkhave purisapuggalassa yañ c' eva kāyakammaṃ yathādiṭṭhisamattaṃ samādiṇṇaṃ yañ ca vacīkammaṃ --pe-- yañ ca manokammaṃ yā ca cetanā yā ca patthanā yo ca paṇidhi ye ca saṃkhārā, sabbe te dhammā aniṭṭhāya akantāya amanāpāya ahitāya dukkhāya saṃvattantīti."
